gate.rule: The ridge side of the same run against reports/evaluation/rasid.json: the day count, each origin's date and ridge 80% coverage and each policy's verified-plan count exactly; the mean and per-origin ridge and seasonal-naive load MAE within 1e-09 kW; the candidate and candidate_risk_neutral totals within 0.0005 relative (the shipped file was solved with another SciPy); the other policies' totals within 1e-06 relative.

identity.note: manifest_sha256 is the SHA-256 of this machine's signed import (mizan-manifest.json, whose seal carries a local signature), while manifest_object is core.contract.digest of the signed manifest object (the pin and each file's SHA-256), reproducible by anyone re-importing the pin.

notes: The ridge view (baseline) and the Chronos view (model) come from one rasid_hf run: the same origins, actual hours, planner settings and verifier, each policy carrying its own battery state and month-to-date peak.
Paired comparisons use only this run's costs; the gate compares the ridge totals with the shipped file (gate.total_cost_relative_difference), not single days.

repeat_run.method: the whole evaluation of this system again in the same process, the model loaded again

settings.chronos_context: the contiguous run of hours known at the origin (vintage rule), ending the hour before it; the loader passes at most its last 2048 values for each series

determinism.applied_by: mizan.models._torch, called by every loader after the checkpoint is verified

settings.forecast_note: Accuracy on the load series, as in the shipped evaluation. MAE of the ridge point forecast, the seasonal-naive path and the Chronos median (0.5). Pinball loss and truncated CRPS from quantile_scores on the shared levels 0.1, 0.5 and 0.9 for both forecasters; 80% coverage between 0.1 and 0.9. The forecaster sees only the contiguous run of hours known at the origin, and that run must end at the hour before the origin, so that its 24 steps are the planned day; otherwise the run stops (CONTEXT).
settings.pairing: load quantile path j with solar quantile path 4 - j, j = 0 to 4
settings.quantile_repair: Chronos quantiles are sorted across levels at each hour (monotone rearrangement), in the loader and again in the harness, and solar values below zero are clipped at zero before scoring and planning (counted in pv_values_clipped); load is not clipped
settings.scenario_rule: Five equally weighted scenarios (weight 0.2 each) from the forecaster's quantiles at levels 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 and 0.9, numbered j = 0 to 4: scenario j pairs load quantile path j with solar quantile path 4 − j, so high load meets low solar. Before pairing, each hour's quantiles are sorted across levels (monotone rearrangement) and solar values below zero are clipped at zero (counted in pv_values_clipped). Load quantiles are not clipped: a negative load value stops the run at the planner's input check. The chronos and chronos_risk_neutral policies are the candidate (risk weight 0.35) and candidate_risk_neutral problems with only these weights and scenarios replaced; the ridge policies keep their four reduced residual scenarios as shipped.
